## Verdict

Acme Desk costs least for a team of 6, at $48 per month. Its 1-seat minimum means a 6-person team pays for exactly 6 seats, while Fennel HQ and Kelp both force payment for unused seats.

## Vendors

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Acme Desk | $8 | 1 |
| Fennel HQ | $12 | 10 |
| Kelp | $17 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

- **Acme Desk:** team of 6 exceeds the 1-seat minimum, so 6 seats are paid. 6 × $8 = **$48 per month**.
- **Fennel HQ:** the 10-seat minimum exceeds the team of 6, so 10 seats are paid. 10 × $12 = **$120 per month**.
- **Kelp:** the 25-seat minimum exceeds the team of 6, so 25 seats are paid. 25 × $17 = **$425 per month**.

Acme Desk is $72 per month cheaper than Fennel HQ and $377 per month cheaper than Kelp. Over twelve months that is $576 versus $1,440 versus $5,100.

## Risks

Seat minimums dominate this comparison, so the ranking is sensitive to growth. Fennel HQ's effective rate at 6 people is $20 per seat ($120 ÷ 6), but it falls to its list $12 once the team reaches 10 — at which point Acme Desk costs $80 and Fennel HQ costs $120, so Acme Desk still leads on price alone. Kelp does not reach its list rate until 25 seats ($425 versus Acme Desk's $200), so it is not price-competitive at any size in this range.

This analysis covers price only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, or contract terms, so a cheaper seat may not be a comparable product. All figures assume monthly billing as stated; annual commitments or negotiated discounts are not on the price list and could change the ranking. Confirm whether minimums are enforced at signup or only at renewal.
